extend.label: Extend by days
extend.hint: Each learner is extended from their own current expiry, so nobody loses time they already had. Already-expired learners are counted from today.

setDate.label: Set the same expiry date for everyone
setDate.hint: Every selected learner ends on this exact date, whatever they have now.

unlimited.label: Give unlimited access
unlimited.hint: Removes the expiry entirely for every selected learner.

config.changePrompt_one: Change course access for {{count}} selected learner.
config.changePrompt_other: Change course access for {{count}} selected learners.
config.negativeHint: Use a negative number to shorten access.
config.applyToEveryCourse: Apply to every course these learners are enrolled in
config.batchesHint_one: Off by default — only the {{count}} batch shown in this list is changed.
config.batchesHint_other: Off by default — only the {{count}} batches shown in this list are changed.
config.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Extending everyone after the schedule change
config.reasonHint: Stored on every access-history row this change writes.
